verses.english: Numbered Discourses 5.249
25. Bad Conduct
A Charnel Ground
“Mendicants, there are these five drawbacks to a charnel ground.
What five?

verses.pali: Asuci, duggandhā, sappaṭibhayā, vāḷānaṁ amanussānaṁ āvāso, bahuno janassa ārodanā—
verses.english: It’s filthy, stinking, frightening, a gathering place for savage monsters, and a weeping place for many people.

verses.pali: ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā sivathikāya.
verses.english: These are the five drawbacks of a charnel ground.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, pañcime ādīnavā sivathikūpame puggale.
verses.english: In the same way there are five drawbacks of an individual like a charnel ground.
What five?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo asucinā kāyakammena samannāgato hoti;
verses.english: To start with, an individual has filthy conduct by way of body, speech, and mind.
This is how they’re filthy, I say.
That individual is just as filthy as a charnel ground.

verses.pali: Tassa asucinā kāyakammena samannāgatassa, asucinā vacīkammena samannāgatassa, asucinā manokammena samannāgatassa pāpako kittisaddo abbhuggacchati.
verses.english: Because of their filthy conduct, they get a bad reputation.
This is how they’re stinky, I say.
That individual is just as stinky as a charnel ground.

verses.pali: Tamenaṁ asucinā kāyakammena samannāgataṁ, asucinā vacīkammena samannāgataṁ, asucinā manokammena samannāgataṁ pesalā sabrahmacārī ārakā parivajjanti.
verses.english: Because of their filthy conduct, good-hearted spiritual companions avoid them from afar.
That’s how they’re frightening, I say.
That individual is just as frightening as a charnel ground.

verses.pali: So asucinā kāyakammena samannāgato, asucinā vacīkammena samannāgato, asucinā manokammena samannāgato sabhāgehi puggalehi saddhiṁ saṁvasati.
verses.english: Because of their filthy conduct, they live together with individuals of a similar character.
This is how they gather with savage monsters, I say.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi sā, bhikkhave, sivathikā vāḷānaṁ amanussānaṁ āvāso;
verses.english: That individual is just as much a gathering place of savage monsters as a charnel ground.

verses.pali: Tamenaṁ asucinā kāyakammena samannāgataṁ, asucinā vacīkammena samannāgataṁ, asucinā manokammena samannāgataṁ pesalā sabrahmacārī disvā khīyadhammaṁ āpajjanti:
verses.english: Because of their filthy conduct, when good-hearted spiritual companions see them they complain:

verses.pali: ‘aho vata no dukkhaṁ ye mayaṁ evarūpehi puggalehi saddhiṁ saṁvasāmā’ti.
verses.english: ‘Oh, it’s so painful for us to have to live together with such as these.’
This is how there’s weeping, I say.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi sā, bhikkhave, sivathikā bahuno janassa ārodanā;
verses.english: This person is just as much a weeping place for many people as a charnel ground.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā sivathikūpame puggale”ti.
verses.english: These are the five drawbacks of an individual like a charnel ground.”
